adjoint: matrix conjugate transpose (A.conjTranspose); self-adjoint means A.conjTranspose = A

algebra_rep.representation: pi(a) acts blockwise on the 32-dim space; SM generators genC/genH/genM in MartinettiRep.lean

basis_order_note: Option A enumeration (Scaffold32.lean `partner` docstring): H_L 0-7, H_R 8-15, H_L^c 16-23, H_R^c 24-31. Quark slots use index 2+2c+s with c in {0,1,2} color, s in {0,1} isospin; the s<->(u/d) identification is NOT pinned here. Antiparticle partner map: partner(i) = i+16 for i<16, i-16 otherwise (involutive, proved).

checksum_certificate.note: sha256 of the Lean source files carrying these conventions, at freeze time

fluctuated_dirac: fluctuatedDirac D_F A = D_F + A + oppositeOneForm A; oppositeOneForm A = UJ * A.transpose * UJ (InnerFluctuations.lean, machine-checked). NOTE: includes the transpose; J_F A J_F^-1 form with UJ^2 = 1.

fluctuation_basis.direction_note: 10 SM tangent directions (Re/Im of yNu,yE,yU,yD,yR) + 12 exotic survivors (Re/Im x 6 color-universal cross-sector types). smDir* in CFKernel22.lean; exotic* in CFKernelRetarget.lean.
fluctuation_basis.independence: linearly independent (dirs22_independent, proved via 11 disjoint entry pivots). NOT orthonormal.

gauge_action: unitary conjugation D_A -> U D_A U^* (convention; gauge-transformation lemmas live in InnerFluctuations.lean, not re-verified in this freeze)

grading.gamma_convention: gammaF = diag(+I_8, -I_8, -I_8, +I_8) on (H_L, H_R, H_L^c, H_R^c) — the CHIRAL grading (Scaffold32.lean). NOTE: not diag(+1,-1).

quaternionic_blocks.ordering: q = a + b*i + c*j + d*k (conventional; not machine-checked here)

real_structure.J_commutes_with_gamma: J-compatibility with gammaF holds per IsJCompatible-style relation; not asserted as commutation
real_structure.J_compatibility: IsJCompatible D := UJ * D.transpose * UJ = D. NOTE: this is NOT commutation J*D = D*J.
real_structure.J_convention: UJ : Matrix I32 I32 C, UJ i j = 1 iff j = partner i (permutation matrix from the involutive partner map). Antilinear J acts via UJ with entrywise conjugation.

sm_dirac.block_structure: off-diagonal Yukawa block + conjugate block + Majorana block; one generation only
sm_dirac.definition: smDirac yNu yE yU yD yR = buildDirac (yukawaBlock yNu yE yU yD) ((yukawaBlock yNu yE yU yD).map (starRingEnd C)) 0 (majoranaBlock yR) (MartinettiRep.lean). Yukawa block sits in the (H_L, H_R) off-diagonal: smDirac .. 0 8 = yNu, smDirac .. 1 9 = yE (proved).

trace: ordinary UNNORMALIZED matrix trace (Matrix.trace / LinearMap.trace). NOTE: not normalized by 1/32.

yukawa.multiplicity_note: 3x for u,d quarks (color), 1x for leptons (SA-1 kill gate K3). NOT 3 for all.
yukawa.three_generation_note: finite triple is one-generation; three generations live in ThreeGen.lean (smDirac3diag, 96-dim), separate
